mainText: Good morning. Thursday, October 22. Stocks are sharply lower this morning. Nasdaq 100 futures are down 1.7 percent, S and P 500 futures down 1.0 percent, and Dow futures down 0.6 percent. A I spending worries are back in the driver's seat, and tensions with Iran are pushing oil toward 112 dollars a barrel. The ten year Treasury yield is 5.05 percent, down from 5.13 percent yesterday, as investors flee to safety. In premarket movers: Tesla down 5 percent, Meta down 2 to 3 percent, Lam Research down 7 percent, I B M down 6 percent, Spotify up 5 percent, and Lockheed Martin up 3 to 4 percent.
